notes: Specs taken from WyreStorm's own "NetworkHD Full Product Range Specification Sheet" (231130, Copyright 2023), page 7, which lists the NHD-500-TX as a distinct column from the NHD-500-RX/DNT-TX/IW-TX. This is the original (v1) NHD-500-TX (JPEG2000 encoder), not the newer NHD-500-TX v2 (which adds an HDMI loop-out and a second Ethernet port for Dante AV-A/local network) — WyreStorm's live product page now merges v1/v2 marketing copy under "NHD-500-TX/RX V2", but the linked spec-sheet PDF still documents the original single-HDMI, single-RJ45 I/O set used here. The 5-pin balanced analog audio output and 3-pin RS-232 connector are captive-screw terminal blocks (Phoenix-style); mapped to "euroblock" as the closest available connector id. Unit is a compact desktop enclosure (215 x 120 x 25 mm) — rack mounting requires the optional NHD-000-RACK4 accessory shelf (6U, holds up to 12 units), so it is not itself a fixed rack-unit device (rackUnits omitted). No grade stated for the SFP fiber port's electrical/optical class beyond "1Gbps" so it is graded eth-1g same as the copper RJ45 (spec sheet states "1x 1GbE RJ45" and "1x 1Gbps SFP" as parallel/uplinked 1GbE network ports, not simultaneous independent links — treated here as two physical ports of the same 1GbE network segment, consistent with the datasheet's Network row listing both together).

ports.name: Analog Audio Out
ports.note: 5-pin balanced analog audio output, Phoenix-style captive screw terminal block

ports.name: SFP
ports.note: 1Gbps SFP cage; supports 1000Base-SX (550m OM3 MMF), 1000Base-LX (5km SMF), 1000Base-LX10 (10km SMF) modules

ports.name: RS-232
ports.note: 3-pin Phoenix-style captive screw terminal block, 2-way API programmable

ports.name: IR TX
ports.note: 3.5mm TS mono jack, API programmable; connector list has no 3.5mm TS id so mapped to closest 1/4in mono type

ports.name: USB
ports.note: USB 2.0 Type-A host port, max 300Mbps upstream

ports.name: DC In
ports.note: 12V DC 1A external power supply; also 802.3af PoE compliant via the LAN port
